text: Nexans SA is a listed company: its shares are quoted on Euronext Paris (Compartment A), ISIN FR0000044448, ticker NEX. As of 31 December 2025 the estimated distribution of its share capital was institutional investors 81.28% (including Invexans Limited 9.16%, Baillie Gifford 6.14% and Bpifrance Participations 5.20%), employees 3.90%, private investors 7.49%, treasury shares 0.14% and others 7.19% - no controlling shareholder.
short: Nexans SA is listed on Euronext Paris; largest holders are institutional investors, no controlling shareholder.
